scope: Synthetic in-memory React component fixture, observed through Codex browser controls. No PDF worker, API calls, model inference or resource-limit changes.
checks: Stale manual-grid draft disables editing and creation
Every replaced source region must be explicitly selected
Save failure preserves note, selection and merged-cell draft
Successful grid submits captured revision, exact selected identities and merged geometry
Form preview shows stored and visible appearance values separately
Form apply blocks unmapped existing source regions
Form apply blocks stale page previews
Form failure preserves inspected evidence and mappings
Form success submits current preview, exact original and saved field identities, and note
Pointer drawing converts preview coordinates to bounded page geometry
Manual table controls fit a 390px mobile viewport without horizontal overflow
limitations: Component callbacks are synthetic; these checks do not establish backend or worker integration.
No real document recognition accuracy or translation quality was assessed.
Broader acceptance corpus and target-workload qualification remain outstanding.
